claims: Filing Form 4868 by the April 15 deadline provides an automatic six-month extension to file federal income tax returns.
The six-month extension moves the filing deadline from April 15 to October 15.
The extension is only for submitting paperwork; any taxes owed must still be paid by April 15 to avoid penalties.
Electronic payment via IRS Direct Pay, debit/credit card, or Digital Wallet with "Extension" selected as the payment type provides a confirmation number and eliminates the need to file Form 4868.
IRS Free File allows electronic filing of Form 4868 using free tax software regardless of income.
Mailing Form 4868 to the IRS postmarked by April 15 is accepted.
The extension gives more time to submit the tax return but requires estimating and paying tax liability by April 15 to avoid interest and late payment penalties.
Filing an extension prevents the failure-to-file penalty of 5% of unpaid taxes per month, up to 25%.
